name: @ultrst-armada/floks
description: Floks — Public Frontend, 2D Graph & UI Package Library (@floks/*)

scripts.postbuild: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { for (const pkg of fs.readdirSync('packages')) { const d = 'packages/' + pkg + '/dist'; if (!fs.existsSync(d)) continue; for (const f of fs.readdirSync(d, { recursive: true })) { const p = d + '/' + f; if (fs.statSync(p).isFile() && (p.endsWith('.js') || p.endsWith('.d.ts'))) { const c = fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'); const n = c.replaceAll('@kloks/', '@ultrst-armada/kloks/').replaceAll('@floks/', '@ultrst-armada/floks/').replaceAll('@ultrst/kloks/', '@ultrst-armada/kloks/').replaceAll('@ultrst/floks/', '@ultrst-armada/floks/').replaceAll('\"kloks/', '\"@ultrst-armada/kloks/').replaceAll('\'kloks/', '\'@ultrst-armada/kloks/').replaceAll('\"floks/', '\"@ultrst-armada/floks/').replaceAll('\'floks/', '\'@ultrst-armada/floks/'); if (c !== n) fs.writeFileSync(p, n); } } } })"
